_doc: Non-crypto fixtures the in-process differential oracle cannot execute for a STRUCTURAL reason (not a missing crypto witness). Post-mortem remediation #1 added a real deploy->call->Spend path (conformance/witnesses/real-crypto/ via runar-testing runStatefulSpend) and MOVED every stateful fixture whose continuation could be driven and re-validated on @bsv/sdk Spend with a real checkPreimage binding out of this list. The free-text `reason` is for humans; the machine-checked truth of each entry's claim lives in its `coveredBy` field (see coverage-claims.test.ts) — membership in this list is NOT itself treated as coverage. See conformance/witnesses/README.md.

inapplicable.reason: UnsafeSmartContract asm({body:'51'}) raw-script intrinsic is not implemented by the ANF interpreter (source-semantics engine reports 'Unknown function: asm'), so the differential / real-crypto oracles cannot execute it. Instead the compiled OP_1 is executed directly on the go-sdk Bitcoin Script engine (anyone-can-spend, empty unlocking → clean TRUE); deliberately no reject case, since universal acceptance is the contract's semantics.
BabyBear field proof-system primitive is Go-only (compilers:[go]); no TypeScript Stack-IR codegen, compile() cannot emit deployed bytes
BabyBear quartic-extension proof-system primitive is Go-only (compilers:[go]); no TypeScript codegen

sendToScript(): a TWO-output method — addRawOutput(1000, scriptBytes) plus the addOutput(0, count) state continuation. The SDK deploy->call->Spend path (real-crypto/ style) funds a single continuation output; it does not fund/emit the separate 1000-sat raw output, so a real Spend rejects (checkPreimage output binding fails). FOLLOW-UP: build the raw output via CallOptions.outputs so this can also get a tx-context accept/reject differential.

coveredBy.note: conformance/anf-interpreter/cross-interpreter.test.ts runs sendToScript(scriptBytes) through the ANF interpreter (TS reference + Go/Python/Rust/Java/Zig/Ruby drivers where built) and asserts the resulting state + rawOutputs match a pinned golden (conformance/anf-interpreter/expected/add-raw-output-publish.json). This proves cross-tier interpreter correctness of the raw-output intrinsic; it is NOT a tx-context accept/reject differential against compiled Bitcoin Script bytes (no witness/signature-failure path is exercised).

inapplicable.reason: spend(): branched mutation of count + a fixed-width ByteString state field re-encodes state via OP_NUM2BIN. Driven through the SDK call() path the recomputed continuation width does not match (OP_NUM2BIN 'size not large enough') — the harness cannot reconstruct the exact branched serialisation. FOLLOW-UP: port the Go witness construction.

coveredBy.note: both branches (then/else of the len(scratch)-driven conditional) executed via the ANF interpreter with realistic args; TS tier only, not a full Bitcoin Script byte execution, and this particular fixture's spec is accept-only by design (both arms succeed — the branching logic itself is what's under test, not a checkSig/checkPreimage guard).

inapplicable.reason: payBond(): requireOutputP2PKH(0, bondPKH, bondAmount) demands output 0 be a specific P2PKH, but the SDK continuation places the STATE output at index 0 — the harness cannot compose the required output layout. FOLLOW-UP: use CallOptions.outputs to place the bond output.

coveredBy.note: 1 accept + 2 reject (wrong PKH, wrong hashOutputs) executed via the ANF interpreter with witness-injected serialised outputs (TestContract.setSerialisedOutputs / setMockPreimageBytes); TS tier only, not a full Bitcoin Script byte execution.

inapplicable.reason: bind(): extractPrevOutputScript(0, expectedHash) asserts the input's prevout script hashes to a constructor-baked expectedHash — a value only known after the deploy locking script exists (circular for a synthetic harness). FOLLOW-UP: deploy, read back the real prevout script, then re-deploy with its hash.

coveredBy.note: 1 accept + 2 reject (hash mismatch, no witness supplied) executed via the ANF interpreter with witness-injected prevout script bytes (TestContract.setPrevOutScript); TS tier only, not a full Bitcoin Script byte execution.
